_comment: Human-written guidance per issue, merged with fresh numbers on every report run to produce action_queue.csv. Edit freely; the numbers come from the data, these words come from us.

app_crash_or_wont_open.app_side_fix: Find and fix launch failures on the current version; if an install-source or integrity check blocks genuine Play installs, make it fail open with logging instead of locking users out.
app_crash_or_wont_open.first_diagnostic_check: Play Console > Android vitals: crash and ANR rate for the newest version vs the previous one, split by device and Android version. Search crash logs for the 'not installed from Play Store' path.
app_crash_or_wont_open.missing_data: Android vitals by version/device; integrity-check failure counts; whether the check is configurable per client; share of users on company-managed (MDM) devices.
app_crash_or_wont_open.success_metric: Crash/launch-failure mentions in 1-2★ reviews back to the pre-release share within 2 releases; user-perceived crash rate below Play's bad-behaviour threshold.

login_otp_session.app_side_fix: Stop silent logouts (session/token refresh), add OTP retry with a second channel (SMS ⇄ email/WhatsApp) and a visible resend timer.
login_otp_session.first_diagnostic_check: OTP delivery success rate by carrier and hour from the SMS gateway; session-expiry and forced-logout events per user per week.
login_otp_session.missing_data: OTP send/deliver/verify funnel; logout events with reason codes.
login_otp_session.success_metric: OTP delivered-to-verified rate ≥ 97%; forced logouts per active user per month down 80%; login/OTP mentions in 1-2★ halved.

booking_schedule.app_side_fix: Show the booking deadline and who set it before it passes; confirm bookings unambiguously (one state, one notification); allow cancel/modify within the client's rules.
booking_schedule.first_diagnostic_check: Booking attempts vs successful bookings per day, with failure reasons; how many attempts are blocked by cutoff rules per client.
booking_schedule.missing_data: Booking funnel telemetry; per-client cutoff and modification rules.
booking_schedule.success_metric: Booking success rate per attempt; 'booked but told not booked' reports to zero; booking mentions in 1-2★ down 50%.

boarding_checkin.app_side_fix: Notify 'cab arrived' and ask the employee to confirm before any no-show is recorded; let QR/OTP boarding work when GPS accuracy is low.
boarding_checkin.first_diagnostic_check: No-show markings that were later disputed or followed by a complaint; boarding failures by GPS accuracy bucket.
boarding_checkin.missing_data: No-show events with arrival timestamps and driver-call logs; QR scan failures.

routing_pickup_time.app_side_fix: Explain each pickup time (stop N of M, client buffer), show expected ride time at booking, rotate first-pickup position, flag rides over 2.5× the direct time.
routing_pickup_time.first_diagnostic_check: Per employee: ride time vs direct-trip time and route position over the last month, per client.
routing_pickup_time.missing_data: Route plans with per-rider ride time and position; client settings for buffers, fleet size, max ride time.
routing_pickup_time.success_metric: Share of rides over 2.5× direct time; complaints about pickup time/ride length in 1-2★ down 40%.

tracking_eta.app_side_fix: Show ETA as a window, notify only on material changes (>5 min) with a reason, and make live tracking available well before pickup.
tracking_eta.first_diagnostic_check: GPS update frequency from driver devices; ETA error at T-15 min; how long before pickup tracking becomes visible on the current version.
tracking_eta.missing_data: Driver-app GPS ping rates; ETA prediction vs actual arrival.
tracking_eta.success_metric: Median ETA error at T-15 min under 4 minutes; tracking complaints in 1-2★ down 50%.

notifications.app_side_fix: Rate-limit repeat alerts (one delay alert per material change), make notifications dismissible and grouped.
notifications.first_diagnostic_check: Notifications sent per trip by type; repeat-alert counts per trip.
notifications.success_metric: Notifications per trip down; notification complaints in reviews to near zero.

ui_confusing.app_side_fix: Restore one-step booking and 'show only my cab'; ship redesigns behind staged rollout with an in-app 'what changed' and a way back for one release.
ui_confusing.first_diagnostic_check: Task completion time and drop-off for booking on the new vs old flow; staged-rollout cohort comparison of 1★ share.
ui_confusing.missing_data: Funnel analytics per screen; rollout cohorts.
ui_confusing.success_metric: Booking completion rate on the new flow ≥ old flow; 'new update worse' mentions to near zero after next release.

performance_slow.app_side_fix: Cache today's ride details for offline/slow-network opening; cut cold-start network calls.
performance_slow.first_diagnostic_check: Cold-start time and slow-frame rate by device tier (Android vitals).
performance_slow.missing_data: Startup traces; network calls on app open.
performance_slow.success_metric: Cold start under 2s on mid-tier devices; 'slow' mentions halved.

driver_vehicle_service.app_side_fix: In-app 'report this trip' with trip ID attached, routed to the right transport desk, with status visible to the employee.
driver_vehicle_service.first_diagnostic_check: On-time pickup rate and cab-assignment lead time per client/vendor.
driver_vehicle_service.missing_data: Trip-level on-time data; complaint tickets by vendor.
driver_vehicle_service.success_metric: On-time pickup rate per client; share of ops complaints resolved in-app before they reach the Play Store.

safety_incident.app_side_fix: Visible SOS and escort status; every safety mention in a review triggers an internal incident check within 24h.
safety_incident.first_diagnostic_check: Match each safety-related review to trips by date/route where possible; review the SOS flow end to end.
safety_incident.success_metric: 100% of safety reviews acknowledged within 24h and investigated.

support_escalation.app_side_fix: Show the right helpdesk for the employee's company with hours and call-back; in-app complaint with status tracking.
support_escalation.first_diagnostic_check: Helpdesk answer rate and abandoned calls by client; complaint resolution time.
support_escalation.missing_data: Call-centre logs; ticket volume and resolution time per client.
support_escalation.success_metric: Helpdesk answer rate ≥ 90%; complaint status visible in-app for 100% of tickets.

profile_settings.app_side_fix: Self-serve address and pickup-point change request with approval status.
profile_settings.first_diagnostic_check: Address-change requests and turnaround per client.

other.first_diagnostic_check: Read the examples; split into a new category if a theme appears.
